cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I understand. Admit that hiding the sofa page changed my yes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Before we feed him another one, say I should have had both pages.

confusable: Unlike seeking only sofa compensation, A needs the hidden page recognized; borrowed authority accommodates B rescue motive without dropping the apology condition.
comparison: Continuing responsibility for a dog and repair costs differ from an event that has already been cancelled.
